note: Re-judged 2026-11-10 (independent judge, authored none of spec-rfc4301-architecture-gaps). The stale unit TestRFC4301BoundarySPDEntryIsRefusedRatherThanWidened now refuses a port with a bit outside its mask (443 and 0x0100, each under 0x00ff) in both directions, where it refused a 0x00ff mask outright: xfrmSelectorPort now holds a mask-aligned partial mask exactly (it is how an ICMP code block is installed) and refuses only port bits the kernel would ignore. The RFC4301-5.1-4 negative claim says exactly that refusal for the outbound entry. Every earlier refusal case stays, a second input is added, so the unit proves at least what it did. The stack proof stays the two engine outbound-steps units, unchanged. Verdict stands. Prior judgement: Step 2 (match the outbound packet headers against the SPD). Linux keeps no SPD cache, so the match is the kernel SPD lookup over the entries Ze installs through createFirstChildSA, installSPDPolicies and installUnmatched. Positive: from one source, a datagram to 10.1.0.5 meets the Child SA PROTECT entry (ESP at the tunnel endpoint under child.OutboundSPI, XfrmOutNoStates unchanged) and one to 10.3.0.5:7001 meets the operator BYPASS entry (delivered clear, no ESP). Negative: 10.3.0.5 on port 7009, differing from the BYPASS entry only by port, is not bypassed: EPERM, XfrmOutPolBlock +1, not delivered, so the match reads the headers, not the destination alone. Judge ran both units in their own user+net namespace: PASS, not skipped. Records: xfrmPolicyFromParams panic revert red both polarities; author's manual overlays (bypass->BLOCK reddens the positive, discard->ALLOW reddens the negative, scratch p7-ov-*.log) confirm each polarity reads the disposition. Re-judged 2026-09-30 (leftovers): the retired lead-in RFC4301-5.1-1's tags moved here onto the dataplane SPD boundary units, as supplementary builder-level cover of step 2's input: the positive asserts the outbound entry's out direction, 10.0.0.0/24 -> 10.1.0.0/24 prefixes and exact source port 443; the negative asserts a 0x00ff port mask is refused (nil policy) for SADirOut and SADirIn rather than widened. Claims match the assertions. Records: xfrmPolicyFromParams panic revert observed red both polarities. Judge ran both: PASS. Stack proof stays the two engine units.
